cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Alma Morganthau Wertheim, New York, NY, 1920s; Descended in family (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Mrs. Weiner [formerly Mrs. Alma Morganthau Wertheim]. Note: Mrs. Wiener has this picture in the country, and will give me the measurements the next time she is there. It is an oil and of alligator pears in a basket." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: No. 1 Alligator Pears. Painted 1923. Note: Alligator Pears in Basket" [not verified]. Similar to burnished image of a lost charcoal drawing on the verso of cat. no. 335. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. O'Keeffe wrote: "There was a painting of pears in the basket with a line around the outside as a sort of frame (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 31). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A grouping of shiny green avocadoes sits in a brown basket with a curved handle. The basket rests on a circular gray platform. The background of the work is rendered in shades of gray.
title: Alligator Pears
